text:
emma: :rotating_light: noticing a spike in provisioning failures in ap-southeast1 starting ~11:02 UTC. Batches stuck at 'acquire-oob-console' step, GPUs not coming up. impact ~120 GPUs.
raj: saw the same, digging into OOB logs now. seems correlated to recent BMC firmware push at 10:45.
sylvia: link to deploy job? which image tag rolled? I was on call for that window.
emma: deploy job: `infra/oob-firmware:v2026-04-11` rolled to 6 racks. rollout note said "smarter smbus handling".
raj: logs show repeated SMBus resets from BMCs, then IPMI sessions drop. snippet:
```
Apr 11 10:58:12 bmc-76 kernel: i2c i801 0000:00:1f.3: SMBus timeout
Apr 11 10:58:12 bmc-76 ipmi_si: IPMI over KCS: timeout waiting for interrupt
Apr 11 10:58:14 bmc-76 systemd[1]: Stopping OOB service due to watchdog
```
emma: we started seeing secureboot toggles on some nodes when BMC reconnects. weird edge-case: toggles from UEFI to fallback mode.
sylvia: that would cause nodes to re-provision, hence the queue pileup and GPU capacity hit. any quick mitigations?
raj: temporary mitigations: 1) pause firmware rollout, 2) mark affected racks as "draining" in provisioner, 3) mass IPMI session backoff to avoid conn storms.
infra-bot: Deploy job infra/oob-firmware:v2026-04-11 paused by @raj at 11:07 UTC. (runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood/oob/fw-rollback>)
matt: running the rollback plan now. question: do we have a safe BIOS pin to prevent secureboot state flips during BMC recon? would prefer config toggle instead of full reprovision.
emma: there's a flag in the host-boot config: `prevent-secureboot-toggle=true` — can be applied via kvm script without full reprovision for most models.
raj: rolling that flag out to the 6 racks now. will also patch the provisioner to ignore transient secureboot state for 10m windows.
sylvia: can someone check cost/throughput impact? GPUs down => customer throttles, potential SLA hits.
emma: current estimate: 2.3k vGPU-hours delayed, expected catch-up will push extra allocation tonight. finance alert? pinging ops-cost slack.
matt: I'll run a short script to temporarily redistribute queued workloads to eu-west nodes to avoid immediate customer impact. script:
```
for rack in affected_racks; do provisioner.set_awareness($rack, 'avoid', 600) ; done
```
raj: monitoring: after applying `prevent-secureboot-toggle=true` BMCs reconnected and few nodes recovered. still seeing SMBus resets on 4 BMCs.
emma: plan: 1) finish rollback to previous firmware on remaining racks 2) schedule forensic trace on SMBus controller hw 3) add more conservative backoff to BMC client in provisioner 4) incident postmortem.
sylvia: thumbs up. assign owners? raj for rollback, matt for traffic reroute, emma for postmortem, infra-bot schedule meeting?
infra-bot: Meeting scheduled: "oob-sm-bus-provisioning-incident" at 13:00 UTC. Invite: @emma @raj @sylvia @matt
raj: rolling rollback now, reporting back in 20. :thumbsup:
emma: thanks — keep thread updates short. if anything spikes, escalate to oncall immediately.
